title: Course tangent: self-accountability in online learning

cues.en: Hi, everyone, I hope you don't mind if I draw your attention away from the course material for just a moment, I want to talk about an important challenge in online learning.
cues.zh: 大家好，希望不介意我暫時把你的注意力從課程內容移開，談談線上學習的一項重要挑戰。

cues.en: And this is just to get you thinking about this issue now.
cues.zh: 只是希望你現在就開始思考這件事。

cues.en: It will come as no surprise that I'm a huge fan of online education.
cues.zh: 我非常支持線上教育，相信你不意外。

cues.en: It has so many advantages, like access to high quality education at low cost for people all over the
cues.zh: 它有很多優點，例如全球各地的人，都能以低廉費用取得高品質，

cues.en: world, the ability for you, the learner, to custom tailor your education to best match what you want
cues.zh: 教育；你也能依自己的需求量身安排教育內容，配合想要，

cues.en: to learn and of course, the ability to watch and repeat any lecture at any time according to your own schedule.
cues.zh: 學習的事；當然，還能依照自己的時間，在任何時候觀看、重複觀看任一堂課。

cues.en: But online education also has some drawbacks, some limitations and some challenges.
cues.zh: 不過，線上教育也有缺點、限制和挑戰。

cues.en: And here I want to talk about one of those, which is the minimal accountability with online learning.
cues.zh: 這裡想談其中一項：線上學習很少有人督促你負責。

cues.en: You see, when you are in a traditional classroom setting with a teacher and other students, you have
cues.zh: 在傳統教室，有老師和其他同學時，你有，

cues.en: this entire external support structure to keep you going, keep you motivated, and make sure that you are up to date and up to speed with your work.
cues.zh: 一整套外在支持，讓你持續前進、保持動力，確保作業跟得上進度。

cues.en: Make sure that you keep studying consistently throughout the duration of the course.
cues.zh: 確保整段課程期間，都持續規律讀書。

cues.en: And that's really difficult to maintain in online course settings, because very often there is no external accountability.
cues.zh: 在線上課程很難維持這點，因為往往沒有外在的督促。

cues.en: Most of the time it's just you.
cues.zh: 大部分時間只有你自己。

cues.en: So if you work hard or lazy or you work fast or slow, it's pretty likely that no one's going to notice other than you.
cues.zh: 所以，不管你努力或偷懶、做得快或慢，除了你自己，很可能沒有人注意。

cues.en: So no one's going to remind you when you start going a few days or even a few weeks without watching a lecture.
cues.zh: 連續幾天，甚至幾週沒看課，也不會有人提醒。

cues.en: And you know as well as I do that as soon as it becomes easy to take one day off, then it's even easier to take two days off and then three days off than a week off.
cues.zh: 你和我都知道，一旦覺得休息一天很容易，就更容易休息兩天、三天、一週。

cues.en: And we all know where it goes from there.
cues.zh: 之後會怎麼發展，大家都知道。

cues.en: So what I would like you to do after watching this video is to take a moment to reflect on this issue of accountability.
cues.zh: 所以看完這段，希望你花一點時間，反思這個自我負責的問題。

cues.en: How important is it to you?
cues.zh: 它對你有多重要？

cues.en: Is it something that you think about, something you worry about, or maybe you just don't care about it?
cues.zh: 你會思考、擔心，還是其實不在意？

cues.en: Is it challenging for you or is it easy for you to keep yourself motivated and keep working consistently?
cues.zh: 讓自己保持動力、持續努力，對你來說很難，還是很容易？

cues.en: Or are you not worried about consistent progress and you're happy to work one period of time and then take a break and then work for another period of time and so on?
cues.zh: 或者，你不在意持續進步，覺得做一段時間、休息一下，再做一段時間，也很好？

cues.en: Maybe there are tricks that you use that you've developed, that you've learned from other people to help with this issue of accountability and self motivation.
cues.zh: 也許你有自己摸索出來，或向別人學到的小技巧，能幫助自我督促、維持動力。

cues.en: So if you like, you can post a reply to the Q&A for this lecture, but it's totally not necessary.
cues.zh: 如果願意，可以在這堂的問答區留言，但完全不是必要。

cues.en: Mostly, I just want to bring up this important issue to make sure you are thinking about it, because this is something I think about often.
cues.zh: 主要只是提出這個重要問題，確保你有思考，因為我自己也常想這件事。

cues.en: It's I think this is one of the most important challenges and challenges of online education.
cues.zh: 我認為這是線上教育最重要的挑戰之一。
